params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.automatic
params.description: Describes the replication status of a [SecretVersion][google.cloud.secretmanager.v1.SecretVersion] with automatic replication. Only populated if the parent [Secret][google.cloud.secretmanager.v1.Secret] has an automatic replication policy.

params.name: data.user_managed
params.description: Describes the replication status of a [SecretVersion][google.cloud.secretmanager.v1.SecretVersion] with user-managed replication. Only populated if the parent [Secret][google.cloud.secretmanager.v1.Secret] has a user-managed replication policy.
